title: Letter to Samual
wikitext:
The '''Letter to Samual''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|51|The Boran Family}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Little brother, it has been an eternity since we have seen one another. I am currently stranded on an island called Lapidis off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale near the south seas with others in the fleet. We call this place home, and have for a while now, and are repairing our ship.

When repairs are done, I will be stopping to see you and Karl. I look forward to this day very well, and hope you are doing well.

Your Older Brother Arnold
}}
